test_title: PYST 20: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

P # Q means 'P is Q's father',

P % Q means 'P is Q's sister',

P @ Q means 'P is Q's wife', and

P & Q means 'P is Q's brother'.

Based on the above, if 'G @ D # B @ K # J', then how is G related to J?
solution:

Given: G @ D # B @ K # J

It means: G is the wife of D, D is the father of B, B is the wife of K, K is the father of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/172d248663b7e58e6ec082c0458b4bb0a2d63ea8af8fa366e7ce89bfff1325ad.png] 

Thus, G is J's Mother’s mother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
